description: sqli-min LoginServlet: a test that swaps in a recording Db (the sandbox has no DB env) and asserts the username payload does not reach the SQL text; it fails on the vulnerable code

json.expected_failure: attacker-controlled username reached the SQL text
json.rationale: Db.get() needs SHOP_DB_URL, which the sandbox does not set, so a child-first class loader gives LoginServlet a recording Db whose Statement proxy captures the executeQuery argument; while the username is concatenated the payload appears verbatim.
